name: Urge Overkill
label: Touch and Go
lede: Two Northwestern students in lounge suits and medallions, a drummer called Blackie Onassis, and a Neil Diamond cover they cut on a whim that Quentin Tarantino turned into the sound of Uma Thurman dancing.

eras.title: A Parliament lyric and an Albini roommate
eras.text: Nash Kato and Eddie Roeser met as Northwestern students and built Urge Overkill in Chicago's post-punk world, recording with Steve Albini, who had shared a place with them. The early records are noisy and scrappy; the showmanship was coming.

years.h: Nash Kato meets Eddie Roeser at Northwestern University
years.p: Nathan Kaatrud, later Nash Kato, and Eddie "King" Roeser meet as students at Northwestern University in Evanston, Illinois.

years.h: Urge Overkill forms, named from a Parliament lyric
years.p: Nash Kato, Eddie Roeser and drummer Pat Byrne start Urge Overkill in Chicago, taking the name from a phrase in [[Parliament|d1947987-9614-49ae-bd36-8000e6b6f7d0]]'s "Funkentelechy".

years.h: Strange, I... EP, produced by Steve Albini
years.p: Urge Overkill's debut EP comes out on Ruthless Records with [[Steve Albini|a4d486bd-6020-4a36-9c7d-bf5ce174bcd1]] producing. A standalone single, "Lineman", follows in 1987.

years.h: Jesus Urge Superstar, the first album, on Touch and Go
years.p: Urge Overkill's first full-length is again produced by Steve Albini, with Kriss Bataille now on drums. It starts the band's run on Touch and Go.

eras.title: Medallions, Nirvana and a Neil Diamond song
eras.text: Butch Vig and Albini sharpened the sound into arena-sized punk, Blackie Onassis arrived on drums, and the band's matching suits and gold medallions became the act. By 1992 they were opening for Nirvana and had quietly recorded the song that would change their lives.

years.h: Americruiser: Butch Vig produces, college radio bites
years.p: With Jack "Jaguar" Watt of Baron Lesh on drums and [[Butch Vig|ba30915c-4d33-43c5-8c37-ead0b8061517]] producing, Americruiser brings what Wikipedia calls a Stonesy fusion of arena rock and punk, and a college-radio following.

q: I'm Blackie Onassis because I drum in Urge.
years.h: The Supersonic Storybook, with Blackie Onassis on drums
years.p: Johnny Rowan joins as "Blackie Onassis" for Urge Overkill's third album, produced by Steve Albini. Jim Ellison of [[Material Issue|35290bf2-aa8e-412d-8f4e-0b3362044958]], a friend of the band, came up with the title.
years.xp: Rowan took the stage name to match Kato's and Roeser's personas. He said the name was a role, not a description of his life off stage.

years.h: Urge Overkill open for Nirvana on the Nevermind tour
years.p: Urge Overkill are the opening act on [[Nirvana|5b11f4ce-a62d-471e-81fc-a69a8278c7da]]'s American Nevermind tour, the exposure that sets up their jump to a major label.

years.src: Wikipedia: Stull · Wikipedia: Exile in Guyville
years.h: Stull EP: a Kansas "portal to Hell" and a Neil Diamond cover
years.p: Produced by [[Kramer|d898e082-70d1-4a86-ac8e-ecdf89892994]], the Stull EP has Stull Cemetery near Lawrence, Kansas, on its cover. Its opener, a cover of [[Neil Diamond|a42d3fd5-55de-4206-86c3-4fbb5404018f]]'s "Girl, You'll Be a Woman Soon", was recorded on the spur of the moment.
years.xp:
The tombstone in the foreground of the cover marks the grave of Isaac Stull, the town's namesake; urban legends since the 1970s call the cemetery one of the seven portals to Hell. Spin called the EP pretty close to flawless.

The EP's closer, "Goodbye to Guyville", gave [[Liz Phair|149326c2-b8a3-48e3-b3d2-9b5b9593127f]] the title for Exile in Guyville, and Nash Kato took and cropped the photo on that album's cover.
play: Girl, You'll Be a Woman Soon

eras.title: Saturation point
eras.text: The move to Geffen was a deliberate shot at a hit, and it landed: "Sister Havana" on rock radio, a Pearl Jam tour, and then Pulp Fiction. It also made them the target of the loudest voice in Chicago's underground, their old producer.

years.h: Saturation: Urge Overkill's Geffen debut
years.p: Recorded with the Butcher Bros. from December 1992 to January 1993, Saturation has Nash Kato singing lead on almost every song. "Sister Havana" reaches No. 6 on Billboard's Modern Rock chart.
years.xp: Wikipedia calls it a deliberate attempt at a hit record. Nielsen SoundScan counted 277,000 U.S. copies as of 2013. The cover art is the Houston skyline.

years.h: Opening for Pearl Jam, and a song for No Alternative
years.p: Urge Overkill tour as openers on [[Pearl Jam|83b9cbe7-9857-49e2-ab8e-b57b01038103]]'s Vs. tour and give "Take a Walk" to the Red Hot Organization's AIDS benefit album No Alternative.

years.big: "Weiners in suits playing frat party rock"
q: Weiners in suits playing frat party rock.
years.h: Steve Albini's "Three Pandering Sluts" letter targets Urge Overkill
years.p: In a letter to the Chicago Reader, Steve Albini, who had produced Urge Overkill's early records, attacks the band along with [[Liz Phair|149326c2-b8a3-48e3-b3d2-9b5b9593127f]] and [[The Smashing Pumpkins|ba0d6274-db14-4ef5-b28d-657ebde1a396]].
years.xp: The letter, titled "Three Pandering Sluts and Their Music-Press Stooges", answered the press hype around Chicago's scene. Albini had recorded Strange, I..., Jesus Urge Superstar and The Supersonic Storybook.

years.h: Pulp Fiction turns Urge's Neil Diamond cover into a hit
years.p: Quentin Tarantino uses Urge Overkill's "Girl, You'll Be a Woman Soon" for Uma Thurman's scene in Pulp Fiction. The two-year-old recording reaches No. 59 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 37 in the UK.
years.xp: Eddie Roeser said Tarantino knew the band and picked the song after talking it over with Uma Thurman, who dances to it in the film.

eras.title: Exit the Dragon, exit King
eras.text: The follow-up sold overseas but the band was coming apart: Blackie Onassis was using heroin and wrote about it on the record, and Kato and Roeser stopped getting along. By 1997 Urge Overkill was two men on a Sony imprint, and then nothing.

years.h: Exit the Dragon: No. 6 in Australia
years.p: Urge Overkill's second Geffen album reaches No. 6 in Australia and No. 129 in the U.S. On "The Mistake", Blackie Onassis refers to his own drug use.

years.h: Blackie Onassis is arrested for heroin possession
years.p: Not long after Exit the Dragon came out, drummer Blackie Onassis was arrested for heroin possession, Stereogum reported. He struggled with addiction through the mid-1990s.

years.h: Eddie "King" Roeser quits after clashing with Nash Kato
years.p: Tensions between Nash Kato and Eddie Roeser push Roeser out. He goes on to play with ex-[[The Jesus Lizard|dfebd6c0-dae7-4cc8-a8e9-0dbaa382209f]] drummer [[Jim Kimball|93ed63b4-5dc3-4f4d-9a74-b891e0354b76]] as L.I.M.E., and with his brother John in Electric Airlines.

years.h: Nash Kato and Blackie Onassis sign to Sony's 550 Music as a duo
years.p: What's left of Urge Overkill, Nash Kato and Blackie Onassis, signs to Sony's 550 Music. No album follows, and the band's first run ends.

eras.title: Debutante, and the suits come back out
eras.text: Kato made a solo record, then in 2004 he and Roeser patched it up and put Urge Overkill back on stage without Onassis. It took until 2011 for a new album.

years.h: Nash Kato's solo album Debutante
years.p: Six of Debutante's 13 songs are co-written with Blackie Onassis, who plays on it. It is the last music Onassis makes with Kato before losing touch with the band.

years.h: Nash Kato and Eddie Roeser reunite, without Blackie Onassis
years.p: Urge Overkill return with Mike "Hadji" Hodgkiss on bass, Chris Frantisak on keys and Nate Arling on drums, playing the Troubadour, Double Door, First Avenue and the Bowery Ballroom, then Europe and Australia.

years.h: Live at Maxwell's 2/5/04 documents the comeback
years.p: Urge Overkill's reunion show at Maxwell's in Hoboken, New Jersey, comes out as a live album on eMusicLive.

years.h: "Effigy", Urge Overkill's first new song in 15 years
years.p: New York's WRXP-FM premieres "Effigy". On December 1, 2010, Urge Overkill are the musical guests at a roast of Quentin Tarantino.

years.h: Rock & Roll Submarine, the first album in 16 years
years.p: Urge Overkill self-release Rock & Roll Submarine. On October 8, 2011, they open for [[Weezer|6fe07aa5-fec0-4eca-a456-f29bff451b04]] at Riot Fest at Chicago's Congress Theater.

eras.title: Oui, and goodbye to Blackie
eras.text: A second comeback album arrived in 2022. A year later the drummer from the band's glory years died at 57.

years.h: Oui, Urge Overkill's first album in 11 years
years.p: Nash Kato and Eddie Roeser release Oui on Omnivore Recordings, with brothers Nate and Adam Arling on drums and bass.

years.h: Johnny "Blackie Onassis" Rowan dies at 57
years.p: Urge Overkill announced that their drummer from 1991 to 1997 had died. The band did not give a cause of death. Rowan played on Saturation, Exit the Dragon and the Pulp Fiction cover.

years.h: Exit the Dragon 30th anniversary on pink and purple vinyl
years.p: Porterhouse Records reissues Urge Overkill's Exit the Dragon for its 30th anniversary as a limited pink and purple vinyl pressing.

sources.title: Stereogum: Urge Overkill drummer Johnny 'Blackie Onassis' Rowan has died
